description: Add a new person to the user's workspace, optionally with traits already known (e.g. an MBTI type from a past assessment). Use invite_person instead when the person should take the assessment themselves. Returns the new profile id. Costs 1 unit.

attachment_style.description: Optional. Personal data: never used in business context.

date_of_birth.description: Optional YYYY-MM-DD. Personal data: never used in business context.

department.description: Optional team or department, used by score_team, prep_meeting and suggest_lead.

disc_type.description: Optional DISC style: D, I, S, C or a blend such as DI.

email.description: Optional email; used to match results if they later take the assessment.

enneagram_type.description: Optional Enneagram type 1-9, with wing if known, e.g. 3w2.

mbti_type.description: Optional four-letter MBTI type, e.g. INTJ.

name: create_profile
title: Add a person
